data.name: Ash Survival
data.detailed_description:
Survive. Build. Ride. Trade. Defend.

Ash Survival is an open-world survival game set on a remote island covered in dense forests, abandoned buildings, and scattered resources. Scavenge for supplies, build a secure base, grow your own food, and defend what’s yours.

Explore the island to discover lootable houses, usable vehicles, and valuable natural resources. Use bikes and cars to travel faster—but be careful: each vehicle has a damage and fuel system, so driving comes at a cost. There’s no fixing them—use them wisely or lose them.

The island is not safe—aggressive animals roam the wild and won’t hesitate to attack. Survive harsh weather conditions, manage your body temperature, and adapt to a dynamic day and night cycle that affects visibility and danger. Eat and drink with animated food and water systems that keep your character alive and healthy.

Build a base powered by generators, set up player-run vending machines to trade with others, and deploy automated turrets to keep your home secure. Whether you're farming to survive or building to dominate, your strategy is your story.

Key Features:

  • Open-world island survival – Explore, loot, and survive on a dangerous forested island.

  • Dynamic weather and day/night cycle – Adapt to storms, sunlight, and darkness.

  • Body temperature system – Stay warm, stay cool, and survive harsh environments.

  • Vehicles with damage and fuel systems – Use bikes and cars to travel, manage fuel and damage.

  • Base building with power – Construct your own home, wire up power, and place defenses.

  • Aggressive wildlife – Face dangerous animals that can hunt or ambush you.

  • Farming system – Grow food to stay alive or profit from harvests.

  • Animated food and drink – Stay fed and hydrated with immersive, animated consumption.

  • In-game text chat – Communicate with other players in real time.

  • Vending machines – Sell your items to other players in a live economy.

  • Turret defence – Automate your base’s protection.

  • Gathering and crafting – Mine rocks, chop trees, collect plants, and craft gear.

Survive the island your way—solo or with others—in a game where the environment, weather, wildlife, and other players can be your greatest threat… or your best ally.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card with DirectX 11 support

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature content not suitable for all audiences. It includes frequent depictions of realistic violence, blood, and death. Players may engage in combat resulting in visible injury, killing, and exposure to corpses. Some scenes include grotesque or disturbing violence.

The game also features drug and alcohol use. The player character can consume alcohol (causing visual distortion) and use injectable substances for healing. Hemp can be grown and traded between players. These depictions are stylized but resemble real-world substance use.

Characters may appear in underwear or revealing clothing, but there is no nudity, sexual activity, or sexual violence present.

Online interactions are present, including global text chat, and may expose players to unmoderated user-generated content.
